name: stream-machine
description: OBS and Stream Deck controls for your desktop. Hosted Twitch tools come from the Stream Machine Site plugin.

interface.longDescription: Stream Machine Desktop is a desktop-only add-on that gives ChatGPT OBS and USB Stream Deck controls for your desktop. It needs the Stream Machine Site plugin for Twitch, clips, and the Stream Machine menu. The package's other tools are disabled in source and not exposed.
interface.defaultPrompt: Check OBS and my Stream Deck. Use the Stream Machine Site plugin for Twitch.
